name: telegram-ai-copilot-g2
description: Telegram AI Copilot for Even Realities G2 smart glasses

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:g2
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/g2-app run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:g2 && npm run test:backend
scripts.pack: npm run build:g2 && evenhub pack apps/g2-app/app.json apps/g2-app/dist -o telegram-ai-copilot.ehpk
